title: Let different elements share a set of styles
goal: Use selector lists to share text styles for event titles and event times.
summary: Separate multiple selectors with commas. If an element matches any of these selectors, the common declaration will be applied.
tasks: Use commas to connect h2 and .time-label in a rule.
Change the text color of the event name and time to #264a7c, and reset the font to 600. Keep the event description and main page title in their original colors.
hint: Comma separates h2 and .time-label. When choosing the class name for time, note that the description paragraph also uses the p tag.

example.note: When setting the same background for the website header and footer, you can combine the two element selectors in one rule.
